useCase: Golf round recap cards from the numbers every golfer writes on a paper scorecard: hole-by-hole par and strokes for the front and back nine, Out/In/Total and to-par, one clean deterministic card per round instead of a photo of the crumpled paper
who: Golfers who keep a paper scorecard and post their rounds - r/golf and the golf forums (GolfWRX, MyGolfSpy), where the crumpled-scorecard photo is the standard post
title: Golf Round Scorecard
